moved_to_genbu.description: Genbu Assistant now looks recipes up itself, for every Genbu Show with Recipes on, and took over the SearXNG address. Untick "Genbu Rezepte" in your conversation agent's options and remove this integration. It already stands back, so nothing is found twice.
